'''Jett's Chute''' was part of the final stretch of canyon of the [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] circuit and a seriously dangerous section of the circuit. It was here that [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin's]] engines overheated in lap three of the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]].<ref name="ItWoSWE1" />
